assessment.nobel_worthiness: Induced degradation of proteins through recruited E3 ligases is a new pharmacological modality, turning ubiquitin-proteasome biochemistry into a drug-design principle. It is conceptually original, mechanistically clear and clinically active, and it opens targets that inhibitors cannot reach.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies launched the PROTAC concept (Sakamoto, Crews, Deshaies 2001) and Crews developed it chemically; Ciulli supplied the structure-guided VHL ligands and ternary-complex mechanism. Handa, Ito and Kim concern the cereblon/thalidomide molecular-glue mechanism, a related but distinct compound strand. A trio around PROTACs is workable, but the glue-degrader side makes the boundary uncertain.
assessment.maturity: Many degraders are in clinical trials, with first late-stage readouts; the mechanism is widely reproduced across labs. Clinical approval is still pending, but the chemical-biology impact is already established.
uncertainties: Whether PROTACs and molecular glues (cereblon) should be recognized together or separately
Contribution of Sakamoto versus Ciulli to the founding concept is debatable
Approved-drug validation not yet in place

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing by synthesis with reversible terminator nucleotides transformed biology and medicine; the underlying chemistry of nucleotide analogues and surface-bound polymerase reactions is a chemical invention with enormous impact. For a nucleotide biochemist the dependence on dNTP analogue design is directly relevant.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman founded Solexa and developed the reversible-terminator, single-molecule-array approach that became Illumina sequencing. Rothberg (454 pyrosequencing), Mayer (clusters) and Ju (terminators) are parallel or related contributions, so credit is shared among competing platforms and a fair configuration is contestable.
assessment.maturity: Technology is mature and ubiquitous for two decades, so recognition would be timely or overdue.
uncertainties: Several competing technologies (454, SOLiD, Illumina) make the decisive credit contested
Prize may be considered more a physiology/medicine or technology matter than chemistry
Role of Mayer and Ju relative to the Solexa founders is unclear to me

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the enabling chemistry for siRNA and mRNA medicines, including the COVID-19 vaccines. The discovery is an optimization of lipid pKa and formulation that made nucleic-acid delivery practical, with clear lasting impact.
assessment.attribution: Cullis and colleagues (Madden, Hope, MacLachlan) developed the ionizable lipid and formulation concepts; Anderson and Langer contributed lipidoid libraries and high-throughput discovery. Many contributors and company-linked work (Acuitas, Arbutus, Alnylam) make a three-person cut contentious; Cullis is the strongest single name.
assessment.maturity: Clinically validated at global scale after 2020; the 2023 Medicine prize recognized mRNA modification but not the delivery chemistry, so timing is plausible.
uncertainties: Attribution between Cullis group and Anderson/Langer is contested
Overlap with the 2023 Medicine prize may reduce appetite
Patent disputes and industrial contributions complicate credit

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Proteome-wide quantitative mass spectrometry made large-scale protein identification, quantification and modification mapping routine, shifting cell biology toward systems-level measurement. Impact is broad and sustained.
assessment.attribution: Mann (high-resolution, SILAC, MaxQuant), Aebersold (ICAT, SRM, SWATH) and Yates (shotgun, MudPIT) are widely seen as the core trio; Hunt, Heck and Gygi are also strong, so exclusions would be disputed. Fenn/Tanaka already covered ionization in 2002.
assessment.maturity: Mature, extensively confirmed and fully adopted; recognition is timely or somewhat overdue.
uncertainties: Large number of strong claimants beyond the trio
Whether the committee sees this as method refinement after the 2002 prize

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one base into another without double-strand breaks by fusing deaminases to Cas9 nickases, a creative application of nucleic-acid chemistry with immediate therapeutic implications.
assessment.attribution: Liu led both cytosine and adenine base editor development; Komor and Gaudelli were first authors of the decisive papers but were trainees, so the prize more probably goes to Liu alone, with the others optional. Kondo and Nishida (Target-AID) are independent parallel work.
assessment.maturity: Clinical translation has begun with early patient data, but the field is young and CRISPR was recognized in 2020; recognition may be somewhat early.
uncertainties: Early for long-term clinical outcomes
Relationship to prime editing (B038) and the prior CRISPR prize
Credit for trainees and for Kondo/Nishida

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Orthogonal aminoacyl-tRNA synthetase/tRNA pairs add genetically encoded noncanonical amino acids, expanding the genetic code and giving chemists site-specific control over proteins in living cells.
assessment.attribution: Schultz established the first in vivo expansion in 2001 and the orthogonal pair concept; Wang was his early collaborator; Chin extended to eukaryotes and quadruplet codons and whole-genome recoding. Mehl and Yokoyama are important but secondary.
assessment.maturity: Confirmed in many laboratories for two decades; broad use, though practical therapeutic impact is still limited.
uncertainties: Impact is mostly a research tool
Relative standing of Schultz, Wang and Chin
Overlap with Hecht and Furter earlier work I cannot verify

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Liquid-liquid phase separation as an organizing principle for membraneless compartments has reshaped cell biology and raised chemical questions of multivalency and condensate material properties.
assessment.attribution: Brangwynne and Hyman showed P granules as liquids (2009); Rosen provided multivalent interaction principles in vitro; Pappu and Mittag contributed theory and sequence determinants. Credit plausibly Hyman, Brangwynne, Rosen but the choice is uncertain.
assessment.maturity: Rapidly growing but contested; the physiological relevance of many condensates is debated and the functional evidence is uneven, so recognition may be premature.
uncertainties: Disagreement about physiological relevance of condensates
Is it chemistry or biology
Attribution among five principal names

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nitrogenase structure and mechanism concerns how biology reduces dinitrogen under ambient conditions; structures of the FeMo cofactor revealed a unique metal cluster with central carbide, and mechanistic work linked it to the E4 hydride state.
assessment.attribution: Rees (first structures, Kim and Rees 1992), Einsle (interstitial carbide, 2011) and Seefeldt (mechanism, electron-transfer kinetics) are plausible; Dean and Ribbe are also key. Allocation across structure and mechanism is not clear.
assessment.maturity: Structural picture is well confirmed, though catalytic mechanism of N2 binding and reduction is still under active revision, so it is partly mature.
uncertainties: Mechanism of N2 reduction still unresolved
Many contributors across decades
Haber-Bosch is already recognized, so the novelty angle is biological
